Invariants for 可可蝠: Tall chocolate-brown wrapped-wing cocoon; huge thick caramel furry shawl collar framing small friendly brown face, short pink-lined ears, pug nose with two tiny lip wattles, blushing cheeks, tiny feet. Preserve the tall blanket body and fluffy collar, never a round generic bat.
Output one transparent PNG sprite sheet: EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows; total 12 poses. Landscape 4:3 layout with square cells. Aim 2048 by 1536 pixels. Space rows and columns evenly; never allow an ear/prop to enter another cell. Actual alpha transparency. Feet/body keep a consistent local position except explicitly moving actions. All props stay small so the bat remains clearly recognizable at Watch size.
Each row is a DIFFERENT action below; read each row LEFT TO RIGHT across four successive keyframes: setup, anticipation, main action, settle. Tell the full specified beat, not four duplicate rest poses. Reuse the original neutral character pose closely for setup where appropriate. Change only the body parts relevant to that action.
